turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Yeah, it was really good. Focused on my upper body today. I'm definitely feeling it now, though.

turns.text: We do. Grace and I are planning to just relax on the couch and watch a cooking competition show that we've been meaning to catch up on.

turns.text: That sounds like the perfect way to spend a Monday night. Those cooking competition shows can be so entertaining. Do you two ever get recipe ideas from them?

turns.text: Sometimes we do, but mostly we just marvel at how fast they can chop things under pressure. I think I'll stick to my chemistry experiments and woodworking!

turns.text: Not right now, just planning to finish up a small table I've been sanding. But tonight is strictly for putting my feet up.
